claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.item_proximity
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The activation is gated by being within 5 feet of the item, which the current activation/equipment predicate vocabulary cannot encode.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "While you are within 5 feet of this brazier, you can take a Magic action..."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpawnedCreaturePlacement.nearest_unoccupied_space_to_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The summon location is anchored to the item and chooses the nearest valid space, not a generic self/point range.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the brazier as possible..."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpawnedCreatureCatalogRefOverride.understands_caster_languages
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Catalog-ref summoned creatures currently cannot carry this language-comprehension override from the item text.
